## Group/general info
#Purpose:
This is an R Markdown document for the modeling group project model extension by Adelaide Dahl

```{r libraries}
library(vegan)
```

#Parameters
for Table 1 in the paper - setting parameters for the models
```{r parameter, echo=FALSE}
#VARIABLES
#CL  #live coral on open substrate
#CD  #dead coral
#CP #Live coral on dead coral
#ME #Exposed macroalgae
#MP #Protected macroalgae
#S #Empty space; colonizable by coral or macroalgae

#PARAMETERS (change in proportional cover/year)
gc <- 0.1 #growth rate of coral
gm <- 0.6 #growth rate of macroalgae
gmc <- 0.06 #Overgrowth rate of macroalgae onto live coral
dc <- 0.001 #Death rate of coral
dm <- 0.05 #Senescence rate of macroalgae
e <- 0.01 #Erosion rate of dead coral
gammaC <- 0.001 #Open settlement rate of coral
settlement <- 1 #Multiplier for rate of coral settlement onto dead coral
gammaM <- 0.001 #Open settlement rate of macroalgae
h <- 0.3 #Ambient herbivory rate
p <- 0.5 #Algal protection; degree to which ambient herbivory is reduced for protected macroalgae
f <- 0.1 #frequency of disturbance

```


#Emma (equation 1)
```{r}
#change in proportional live coral on the reef over time (dCL/dt)
#equation_1 <- gc*CL*S + gammaC*S - gmc*CL*(ME+MP) - dc*CL - fCL
```


#Equation 2
```{r}

#dCD/dt
#equation_2 <- dc*(CL+CP)+ MP*(h*(1-p)+dm)- gc*CP*CD-S*gammaC*CD-gm*CD*(ME+MP) - gammaM*CD- e*CD + fCL

```


#Equation 3
```{r}
#change in proportional cover of live coral growing on dead coral over time (dCP/dt)
#dCP/dt = GC* CP*CD + s*gammaC*CD - gmc*CP*(ME+MP) - dc*CP - e*CP
#equation_3 <- gc*CP*CD + settlement*gammaC*CD - gmc*CP*(ME + MP) - dc*CP - e*CP - fCD

```

#Equation 4
```{r}
#dME/dt= gm*ME*S + gammaM*S - ME(h+dm)
#equation_4 <- gm*ME*S + gammaM*S - ME*(h+dm) + f*CD*CL
```


#Equation 5
```{r}
#dMP/dt = gm*MP*CD +gm*ME*CD + gmc*CL(ME+MP) +gmc*CP*(ME+MP) + gammaM*CD - MP(h(1-p) +dm + e)
#equation_5 <- gm*MP*CD +gm*ME*CD + gmc*CL*(ME+MP) +gmc*CP*(ME+MP) + gammaM*CD - MP*(h*(1-p) +dm + e) + f(ME + MP)
```

#Equation 6
```{r}
#S = 1 - CL - CD - CP - ME - MP
#equation_6 <- 1 - CL - CD - CP - ME - MP
```


#Begin model simulation 1


#Initial conditions
```{r}
#VARIABLES
#CL  #live coral on open substrate
#CD  #dead coral
#CP #Live coral on dead coral
#ME #Exposed macroalgae
#MP #Protected macroalgae
#S #Empty space; colonizable by coral or macroalgae

#PARAMETERS (change in proportional cover/year)
gc <- 0.1 #growth rate of coral
gm <- 0.6 #growth rate of macroalgae
gmc <- 0.06 #Overgrowth rate of macroalgae onto live coral
dc <- 0.001 #Death rate of coral
dm <- 0.05 #Senescence rate of macroalgae
e <- 0.01 #Erosion rate of dead coral
gammaC <- 0.001 #Open settlement rate of coral
settlement <- 1 #Multiplier for rate of coral settlement onto dead coral
gammaM <- 0.001 #Open settlement rate of macroalgae
h <- 0.3 #Ambient herbivory rate
p <- 0.5 #Algal protection; degree to which ambient herbivory is reduced for protected macroalgae
fr <- 0 #disturbance parameter - start at 0
```

#Set up our storage variables and fill them with our initial conditions. **Note:** Now we'll need one for each "state" of the population.

#Struture Retaining, higher macrolgae growth rate

```{r}
# create a vector of timesteps
tset1 <- seq(from = 0, to = 200, length.out = 10005)

# create holding vectors and fill initial conditions - inital conditions represent proportional cover of the benthos
CL.simu1 <- NaN*tset1; CL.simu1[1] <- 0.02  #live coral
CD.simu1 <- NaN*tset1; CD.simu1[1] <- 0.7 #dead coral
CP.simu1 <- NaN*tset1; CP.simu1[1] <- 0 #live coral on dead coral
ME.simu1 <- NaN*tset1; ME.simu1[1] <- 0.1 #exposed macroalgae
MP.simu1 <- NaN*tset1; MP.simu1[1] <- 0.18 #protected macroalgae
S.simu1 <- NaN*tset1; S.simu1[1] <- 0 #empty space, not sure what to put here

# for each timestep
for(i in 2:length(tset1)){
  # calculate change in time
	dt <- tset1[i]-tset1[i-1]
	
	# store placeholder variables
	CL <- CL.simu1[i-1]
	CD <- CD.simu1[i-1]
	CP <- CP.simu1[i-1]
	ME <- ME.simu1[i-1]
	MP <- MP.simu1[i-1]
   S <- S.simu1[i-1]
	
	# calculate change in resource level and population size 
	dCL <- (gc*CL*S + gammaC*S - gmc*CL*(ME+MP) - dc*CL)*dt #equation 1
	dCD <- (dc*(CL+CP)+ MP*(h*(1-p)+dm) - gc*CP*CD - settlement*gammaC*CD - gm*CD*(ME+MP) - gammaM*CD - e*CD)*dt #equation 2
	dCP <- (gc*CP*CD + settlement*gammaC*CD - gmc*CP*(ME + MP) - dc*CP - e*CP)*dt #equation 3
	dME <- (gm*ME*S + gm*MP*S + gammaM*S - ME*(h+dm))*dt #equation 4
	dMP <- (gm*MP*CD + gm*ME*CD + gmc*CL*(ME+MP) + gmc*CP*(ME+MP) + gammaM*CD - MP*(h*(1-p) + dm + e))*dt #equation 5
   dS <- (1 - CL - CD - CP - ME - MP)*dt ##equation 6
	
	# calculate total size
	CL.simu1[i] <- CL + dCL
	CD.simu1[i] <- CD + dCD
	CP.simu1[i] <- CP + dCP
	ME.simu1[i] <- ME + dME
	MP.simu1[i] <- MP + dMP
	S.simu1[i] <- S + dS
   
}

#check loop worked
head(CL.simu1)
tail(MP.simu1)

```

#Disturbance frequency Struture Retaining, higher macrolgae growth rate

```{r}
fr <- 0.05

# create a vector of timesteps
tset1 <- seq(from = 0, to = 1000, length.out = 10005)

# disturbance frequency in terms of time steps
disturbance_interval <- 2000  # Apply disturbance every 2000 time steps

# create holding vectors and fill initial conditions - inital conditions represent proportional cover of the benthos
CL.simu1 <- NaN*tset1; CL.simu1[1] <- 0.02  #live coral
CD.simu1 <- NaN*tset1; CD.simu1[1] <- 0.7 #dead coral
CP.simu1 <- NaN*tset1; CP.simu1[1] <- 0 #live coral on dead coral
ME.simu1 <- NaN*tset1; ME.simu1[1] <- 0.1 #exposed macroalgae
MP.simu1 <- NaN*tset1; MP.simu1[1] <- 0.18 #protected macroalgae
S.simu1 <- NaN*tset1; S.simu1[1] <- 0 #empty space, not sure what to put here

# for each timestep
for(i in 2:length(tset1)){
  # calculate change in time
	dt <- tset1[i]-tset1[i-1]
	
	#set disturbance value to nonzero every 200 time steps (indicates presence of disturbance)
	 disturbance <- ifelse(i %% disturbance_interval == 0, fr, 0)
	
	# store placeholder variables
	CL <- CL.simu1[i-1]
	CD <- CD.simu1[i-1]
	CP <- CP.simu1[i-1]
	ME <- ME.simu1[i-1]
	MP <- MP.simu1[i-1]
   S <- S.simu1[i-1]
	
	# calculate change in resource level and population size 
	dCL <- (gc*CL*S + gammaC*S - gmc*CL*(ME+MP) - dc*CL)*dt #equation 1
	dCD <- (dc*(CL+CP)+ MP*(h*(1-p)+dm) - gc*CP*CD - settlement*gammaC*CD - gm*CD*(ME+MP) - gammaM*CD - e*CD)*dt #equation 2
	dCP <- (gc*CP*CD + settlement*gammaC*CD - gmc*CP*(ME + MP) - dc*CP - e*CP)*dt #equation 3
	dME <- (gm*ME*S + gm*MP*S + gammaM*S - ME*(h+dm))*dt #equation 4
	dMP <- (gm*MP*CD + gm*ME*CD + gmc*CL*(ME+MP) + gmc*CP*(ME+MP) + gammaM*CD - MP*(h*(1-p) + dm + e + disturbance))*dt #equation 5
   dS <- (1 - CL - CD - CP - ME - MP)*dt ##equation 6
	
	# calculate total size
	CL.simu1[i] <- CL + dCL - disturbance*CL
	CD.simu1[i] <- CD + dCD  + disturbance*CL
	CP.simu1[i] <- CP + dCP - disturbance*CD
	ME.simu1[i] <- ME + dME - ME*disturbance
	MP.simu1[i] <- MP + dMP - MP*disturbance
	S.simu1[i] <- S + dS
}

#check loop worked
head(CL.simu1)
tail(MP.simu1)

```

#add sponges

```{r}
# create a vector of timesteps
tset1 <- seq(from = 0, to = 200, length.out = 100005)

#sponge parameters
gs <- 0.1 #growth rate of sponges
ds <- 0.03 #death rate of sponges
gammasp <- 0.001 #settlement rate of sponges

# create holding vectors and fill initial conditions - inital conditions represent proportional cover of the benthos
CL.simu.sp <- NaN*tset1; CL.simu.sp[1] <- 0  #live coral
CD.simu.sp <- NaN*tset1; CD.simu.sp[1] <- 0.7 #dead coral
CP.simu.sp <- NaN*tset1; CP.simu.sp[1] <- 0 #live coral on dead coral
ME.simu.sp <- NaN*tset1; ME.simu.sp[1] <- 0.1 #exposed macroalgae
MP.simu.sp <- NaN*tset1; MP.simu.sp[1] <- 0.16 #protected macroalgae
S.simu.sp <- NaN*tset1; S.simu.sp[1] <- 0 #empty space, not sure what to put here
SP.simu.sp <- NaN*tset1; SP.simu.sp[1] <- 0.02 #sponges

# for each timestep
for(i in 2:length(tset1)){
  # calculate change in time
	dt <- tset1[i]-tset1[i-1]
	
	# store placeholder variables
	CL <- CL.simu.sp[i-1]
	CD <- CD.simu.sp[i-1]
	CP <- CP.simu.sp[i-1]
	ME <- ME.simu.sp[i-1]
	MP <- MP.simu.sp[i-1]
   S <- S.simu.sp[i-1]
   SP <- SP.simu.sp[i-1]
	
	# calculate change in resource level and population size 
	dCL <- (gc*CL*S + gammaC*S - gmc*CL*(ME+MP) - dc*CL - gs*SP)*dt #equation 1
	dCD <- (dc*(CL+CP)+ MP*(h*(1-p)+dm) - gc*CP*CD - settlement*gammaC*CD - gm*CD*(ME+MP) - gammaM*CD - e*CD)*dt #equation 2
	dCP <- (gc*CP*CD + settlement*gammaC*CD - gmc*CP*(ME + MP) - dc*CP - e*CP - gs*SP)*dt #equation 3
	dME <- (gm*ME*S + gm*MP*S + gammaM*S - ME*(h+dm) - gs*SP)*dt #equation 4
	dMP <- (gm*MP*CD + gm*ME*CD + gmc*CL*(ME+MP) + gmc*CP*(ME+MP) + gammaM*CD - MP*(h*(1-p) + dm + e) - gs*SP)*dt #equation 5
	dSP <- (gammasp*gs*SP - ds*SP)*dt #new sponge equation
   dS <- (1 - CL - CD - CP - ME - MP - SP)*dt ##equation 6
	
	# calculate total size
	CL.simu.sp[i] <- CL + dCL
	CD.simu.sp[i] <- CD + dCD
	CP.simu.sp[i] <- CP + dCP
	ME.simu.sp[i] <- ME + dME
	MP.simu.sp[i] <- MP + dMP
	S.simu.sp[i] <- S + dS
	SP.simu.sp[i] <- SP + dSP
}

#check loop worked
head(CL.simu.sp)
tail(MP.simu.sp)
```

#attempt2
```{r}
# create a vector of timesteps
tset1 <- seq(from = 0, to = 50, length.out = 10005)



# create holding vectors and fill initial conditions - inital conditions represent proportional cover of the benthos
CL.simu.sp <- numeric(length(tset1)); CL.simu.sp[1] <- 0.1  # Live coral
CD.simu.sp <- numeric(length(tset1)); CD.simu.sp[1] <- 0.5  # Dead coral
CP.simu.sp <- numeric(length(tset1)); CP.simu.sp[1] <- 0.03  # Live coral on dead coral
ME.simu.sp <- numeric(length(tset1)); ME.simu.sp[1] <- 0.1  # Exposed macroalgae
MP.simu.sp <- numeric(length(tset1)); MP.simu.sp[1] <- 0.05  # Protected macroalgae
S.simu.sp <- numeric(length(tset1)); S.simu.sp[1] <- 0.12  # Empty space
SP.simu.sp <- numeric(length(tset1)); SP.simu.sp[1] <- 0.1  # Sponges

# For each timestep
for(i in 2:length(tset1)){
  # Calculate change in time
  dt <- tset1[i] - tset1[i-1]
  
  # Store previous values
  CL <- CL.simu.sp[i-1]
  CD <- CD.simu.sp[i-1]
  CP <- CP.simu.sp[i-1]
  ME <- ME.simu.sp[i-1]
  MP <- MP.simu.sp[i-1]
  S <- S.simu.sp[i-1]
  SP <- SP.simu.sp[i-1]
  
  # Calculate changes
  dCL <- (gc*CL*S + gammaC*S - gmc*CL*(ME+MP) - dc*CL - gs*SP) * dt
  dCD <- (dc*(CL+CP) + MP*(h*(1-p)+dm) + gs*SP - gc*CP*CD - settlement*gammaC*CD - gm*CD*(ME+MP) - gammaM*CD - e*CD) * dt
  dCP <- (gc*CP*CD + settlement*gammaC*CD - gmc*CP*(ME + MP) - dc*CP - e*CP - gs*SP) * dt
  dME <- (gm*ME*S + gm*MP*S + gammaM*S - ME*(h+dm) - gs*SP) * dt
  dMP <- (gm*MP*CD + gm*ME*CD + gmc*CL*(ME+MP) + gmc*CP*(ME+MP) + gammaM*CD - MP*(h*(1-p) + dm + e)) * dt
  dS <- (1 - CL - CD - CP - ME - MP - SP) * dt
  dSP <- (gs*SP*S + gs*CD*SP - ds*SP) * dt  # 
  
    # Normalize if total cover exceeds 1
  total_cover <- CL + CD + CP + ME + MP + SP + S
  if (total_cover > 1) {
    CL <- CL / total_cover
    CD <- CD / total_cover
    CP <- CP / total_cover
    ME <- ME / total_cover
    MP <- MP / total_cover
    SP <- SP / total_cover
    S  <- S / total_cover
  }

  # Store updated values
  CL.simu.sp[i] <- CL + dCL
  CD.simu.sp[i] <- CD + dCD
  CP.simu.sp[i] <- CP + dCP
  ME.simu.sp[i] <- ME + dME
  MP.simu.sp[i] <- MP + dMP
  S.simu.sp[i]  <- S + dS
  SP.simu.sp[i] <- SP + dSP
}

# Check results
head(MP.simu.sp)
tail(MP.simu.sp)

for(i in 2:length(tset1)){
  # Compute total cover
  total_cover <- CL + CD + CP + ME + MP + SP + S

  # Check for NA or NaN
  if (is.na(total_cover) | is.nan(total_cover)) {
    print(paste("Error at i =", i, "CL =", CL, "CD =", CD, "CP =", CP, 
                "ME =", ME, "MP =", MP, "SP =", SP, "S =", S))
    break
  }

  # Original check
  if (total_cover > 1.01) { 
    print(paste("Cover exceeded 1 at i =", i, "Total =", total_cover)) 
  }
}

```

```{r}
#Live coral bifurcation diagram
plot(x = gmset, y = CLstarset,
     type = 'l', lwd = 2, col = CLcol, las = 1,
     xlab = 'Growth Rate of Macroalgae, gm', ylab = 'Stable equilibria of Live Coral Cover, CL*',
     ylim = )

#Exposed Macroalgae bifurcation diagram
plot(x = gmset, y = MEstarset,

```
```{r}
pset <- seq(from = 0, to = 1,length.out = 100) #dont know what numbers to put here

CLstarset <- NaN*pset
MEstarset <- NaN*pset

CDstarset <- NaN*pset
CPstarset <- NaN*pset
MPstarset <- NaN*pset
Sstarset <- NaN*pset

for(j in 1:length(pset)){
    p <- pset[j] 
    
#holding vectors and initial conditions for live coral and exposed macroalgae cover  
    CL.simu6 <- NaN*tset1; CL.simu6[1] <-  0.9  
    ME.simu6 <- NaN*tset1; ME.simu6[1] <- 0.1
    
    CD.simu6 <- NaN*tset1; CD.simu6[1] <- 0 #dead coral
    CP.simu6 <- NaN*tset1; CP.simu6[1] <- 0 #live coral on dead coral
    MP.simu6 <- NaN*tset1; MP.simu6[1] <- 0 #protected macroalgae
    S.simu6 <- NaN*tset1; S.simu6[1] <- 0 #empty space, not sure what to put here


    
    for(i in 2:length(tset1)){
        dt <- tset1[i]-tset1[i-1]
        
        # storing temporary variables
        CL <- CL.simu6[i-1]
        ME <- ME.simu6[i-1]
        
        CD <- CD.simu6[i-1]
      	CP <- CP.simu6[i-1]
      	MP <- MP.simu6[i-1]
        S <- S.simu6[i-1]
        
        # calculating change in population size
        dCL <- (gc*CL*S + gammaC*S - gmc*CL*(ME+MP) - dc*CL)*dt
        dME <- (gm_2*ME*S + gm*MP*S + gammaM*S - ME*(h+dm))*dt
        
        dCD <- (dc*(CL+CP)+ MP*(h*(1-p)+dm) - gc*CP*CD - settlement*gammaC*CD - gm*CD*(ME+MP) - gammaM*CD - e*CD)*dt 
	      dCP <- (gc*CP*CD + settlement*gammaC*CD - gmc*CP*(ME + MP) - dc*CP - e*CP)*dt 
	      dMP <- (gm*MP*CD + gm*ME*CD + gmc*CL*(ME+MP) + gmc*CP*(ME+MP) + gammaM*CD - MP*(h*(1-p) + dm + e))*dt 
        dS <- (1 - CL - CD - CP - ME - MP)*dt 
        
        # calculating total population size
        CL.simu6[i] <- CL.simu6[i-1] + dCL
        ME.simu6[i] <- ME.simu6[i-1] + dME
        
        CD.simu6[i] <- CD.simu6[i-1] + dCD
        CP.simu6[i] <- CP.simu6[i-1] + dCP
	      MP.simu6[i] <- MP.simu6[i-1] + dMP
	      S.simu6[i] <- S.simu6[i-1] + dS
	      
    }
    
    # storing last population size (equilibrium population size) in holding vector
    CLstarset[j] <- CL.simu6[length(tset1)]
    MEstarset[j] <- ME.simu6[length(tset1)]
    
    CDstarset[j] <- CD.simu6[length(tset1)]
    CPstarset[j] <- CP.simu6[length(tset1)]
    MPstarset[j] <- MP.simu6[length(tset1)]
    Sstarset[j] <- S.simu6[length(tset1)]
    
}

#Live coral bifurcation diagram
plot(x = pset, y = CLstarset,
     type = 'l', lwd = 2, col = CLcol, las = 1,
     xlab = 'p', ylab = 'Stable equilibria of Live Coral Cover, CL*',
     ylim = )

#Exposed Macroalgae bifurcation diagram
plot(x = pset, y = MEstarset,
     type = 'l', lwd = 2, col = MEcol, las = 1,
     xlab = 'p', ylab = 'Stable equilibria of Exposed Macroalgae, ME*')
```
